pages.title: 3D-GNOMEᴺᴳ, 3D chromatin structure from ChIA-PET loops and Hi-C
pages.description: 3D-GNOME NG is a free web server that computes ensembles of 3D structures of genomic regions up to 20 Mb from CTCF and RNAPII loops, Hi-C contacts and structural variants.

model.title: Model a region
model.description: Choose a cell type, a region, the loops and a person's structural variants, then build an ensemble of 3D chromatin structures with 3D-GNOME NG.

examples.title: Examples
examples.description: Finished 3D-GNOME NG jobs to open, among them the TNFRSF8 locus with CTCF and RNAPII loops, the GSTM1 deletion and VPS13D in two cell lines.

method.title: Method
method.description: The method of 3D-GNOME NG, from chromatin loops and a contact map to an ensemble of 3D structures, with its target distances, anchor phase, chain phase and validation.

results.title: Results
results.description: Agreement of 3D-GNOME NG models with Hi-C and Micro-C in GM12878, H1ESC and HFFc6, the effect of RNAPII loops, a comparison with cudaMMC and MultiMM and the runtime.

help.title: Help
help.description: A tutorial with sample output, the input formats with sample files, the hosted structural variant sets, a guide to the results and the way to run 3D-GNOME NG on your own computer.

cite.title: Cite
cite.description: The papers and the data sources to cite for structures, figures and data made with 3D-GNOME NG.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.description: The data that the 3D-GNOME NG server stores and for how long, with your rights under the GDPR. The site sets no cookies and does no tracking.

jobs.title: My jobs
jobs.description: The jobs started from this browser.
